Pori Moni in ‘Antarjala’ on Victory Day
2017-12-16T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/showbiz/deshi-grapevine/pori-moni-antarjala-victory-day-1505548

Pori Moni's victory has doubled up with the release of her new film Antarjala yesterday. The movie was released in 175 cinema halls at a time across Bangladesh. Such a huge premier made the movie catchier and striking to the viewers. Zayed Khan, Pori Moni, Joy Chowdhury, Moumita Mou, Miju Ahmed and many other prominent actors have worked in this film. Antarjala is directed by the celebrated director Malek Afsary and produced by Z K Movies. Pori Moni in one of her interviews said that she was confident about her viewers' positive reaction to this movie. With laughter she added, "We will give them their money back if they do not like it." Zayed Khan also shared his thoughts on this film. He commented, " Antarjala has a very eventful plot. I tried to sink into my character as best as possible. The plot revolves around the true story of the eminent Bangladeshi actor Manna. The movie has its unique features."
